description: Handcraft paper from plant fibres — fibre harvesting, pulping, sheet forming with a mould and deckle, pressing, and drying. Covers fibre sources (cotton, kozo, abaca, recycled paper), beating methods, sizing, and decorative techniques. Use when making handmade paper for art, stationery, or bookbinding, when creating unique textured or embedded paper for special projects, or when learning traditional paper making as a craft practice.
